trust_decision.summary: The `split` command must decide, for every spec-derived file name, whether the resolved target still lies inside the resolved `--outDir`; the decision is a single helper that resolves both paths and allows only equality or a `base + path.sep` prefix. At the pinned commit that decision exists nowhere, and each of the six write routes builds its path with `path.join(outDir, <name derived from a spec key>)`.

landing_point.why: The summary names `split` and path traversal; the first thing an engineer reproduces is a `paths` key rendered into `paths/<name>.yaml`, exactly what the published PoC fixture uses (fix.diff:55).

fix_sites.module_kind: cli_command / oas component splitter (guard placed in the gather pass, not at the write on line 70)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory text and both published PoC fixtures are OpenAPI-only (`paths`, `components.schemas`), while the AsyncAPI branch is a separate implementation with its own splittable-type allowlists, so a solver can call it a neighbouring feature outside the reported scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate names still need to expand into nested directories inside outDir (namespaced components, and `--separator /` path files), and names that merely begin with dots (`..foo`) are legitimate; a fix that strips or rejects any name containing `..` or `/` breaks both, which is why the published tests pin 'allows a name that merely starts with dots' and 'allows a path inside the output directory' (fix.diff:26-35).

O6_input_shapes: path key containing `..` segments, rendered through `--separator /` (fix.diff:55)
`x-codeSamples[].lang` value whose later separators survive the non-global escape in escapeLanguageName (packages/cli/src/utils/miscellaneous.ts:151)
AsyncAPI channel name, AsyncAPI 3 operation name, and AsyncAPI 2/3 component name containing `..`
benign look-alikes that must not be rejected: `..foo` and a sibling directory sharing a name prefix (`outsider` vs `out`) (fix.diff:31-43)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second spec-derived file-name builder for another embedded payload (e.g. callback or trait code samples) reusing `codeSamplesPathPrefix + pathToFilename(pathName, pathSeparator)`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the code-sample path is built ad hoc in the same loop that already builds the path file, so a maintainer adding another embedded artefact would copy these two lines

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a tags or x-tagGroups split writing `<outDir>/tags/<tag name>.yaml` from spec-controlled names
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the webhooks branch is already a copy of the paths branch call, so extending the same pattern to another top-level section is the natural edit

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an AsyncAPI `servers` or `components.tags` write loop cloned from the operations loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: servers and tags are listed as component names (packages/cli/src/commands/split/asyncapi/constants.ts:55-73) but not all are splittable, so a maintainer adding one would clone this loop

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file write (CWE-22, CWE-73)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=22.12 or >=20.19 (npm >=11) workspaces; `tsc -b tsconfig.build.json`; vitest 4 via `npm run unit` (VITEST_SUITE=unit)
O10_build.project_tests: packages/cli/src/commands/split/__tests__/index.test.ts (vitest; mocks node:fs writeFileSync and utils.writeToFileByExtension) with fixtures in packages/cli/src/commands/split/__tests__/fixtures/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitise the name where it is built - strip or reject `..`/`/` inside pathToFilename/getFileNamePath - which covers the OpenAPI path and component files but leaves the code-sample `lang` route and the whole AsyncAPI implementation open, and breaks namespaced component names and `--separator /`.

out_of_scope_notes: Other CLI commands (bundle, join, eject) also write output paths, but they are outside this advisory's `split` property and were not examined.
unverified: Repo size in MB could not be measured without shell access; the monorepo is clearly larger than 5 MB of source and far below 1.5 GB.

The second published commit 504120419 patches a monolithic `packages/cli/src/commands/split/index.ts` layout that does not exist at the pinned commit, so its sites were not added to the count; whether it is a re-fix after the module refactor or a parallel branch could not be checked without git history.
Whether the CLI wrapper (`packages/cli/src/wrapper.ts`) performs telemetry or other network calls before `handleSplit` was not traced; the split code path itself reads only local files.
No route into the same write sink was found outside the six fixed call sites, but exhaustiveness was judged by reading the `split` directory only.
